children: RIYADH — A total of 51 Toyota Supra vehicles have been recalled by the Ministry of Commerce due to a defect in the spare tire that may prevent it from being fitted and used during an emergency.
The defect involves the size of the vehicle’s spare tire, which may make it impossible to install and prevent its use when needed in an emergency.
The recall affects 51 Toyota Supra vehicles from the 2026 model year.
The Ministry urged owners to verify whether their vehicles are included in the recall by checking their Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) through Recalls.sa.
Customers were also urged to contact Abdul Latif Jameel Company at 8004400055 to have the wheel rim and spare tire replaced free of charge.

title: ZAWYA: Saudi Arabia recalls 51 Toyota Supra vehicles over spare tire defect
